comment: Squad comms line bank v2. Trigger names are GameEvent names (lib/game/game_events.dart); 'sectorStart.3' is preferred over 'sectorStart' in sector 3, 'weaponPickup.spread' over 'weaponPickup'. Human lines are spoken by the named cast member (Kokoro TTS + radio chain); demon lines are grunts (kind = vocal gesture) shown as brood glyphs with a fleet SIGINT gloss. Speakers not on this run's lineup are skipped; if nobody on the call has a line, a fleet guest patches in. Clip ids are '<trigger>.h<n>' / '<trigger>.d<n>' in list order: append new lines, never reorder. priority 0-10 (>= 8 is gameplay-critical and may interrupt lower speech), cooldown seconds per trigger, ttl seconds a queued line may wait, chance = probability a chatter trigger speaks, delay = seconds before a demon reaction, mood = the face held after the line (happy, worried, stern), chain = extra lines from other crew after the first (celebrations). group = a rate-limit family; groupGap gives the seconds between two lines of one family (ground narration never drowns out the air callouts). 'signature': catchphrases and puns, rationed by the director. v3: every human line has an "emotion" (excited, urgent, panicked, triumphant, teasing, warm, exhausted, calm, stern) for the expressive TTS. "urgent": true marks the only gameplay-critical warnings that may cut a playing line; everything else queues. "exchange": "human"|"demon" makes the trigger a two-party exchange: that side speaks first, the other answers right after, and the channel is reserved for both turns. A demon part with "overlap": true (the regroup celebration) may overlap other voices for about a second. "transmission": true lines play as a full-size transmission in place of a transition on phones. groupGap rate-limits families: ground narration and loot/shield chatter. Tone: allies never die; a downed ship or squad is "totalled" and heads back to base. v4: "divePrep" (a demon is about to start a dive tell) carries brood battle cries; the reinforcements cheer chains a second brood voice; grunt kinds add "cackle" and "warcry".

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Overwatch to squadron. New sector, same promise. Keep them off the fleet.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Beacon on the line. Formation is yours, pilot. Lead us in.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Sparrow on your wing. Let's light them up.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Nomad here. Steady as she goes.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Cadet Pip, reporting for awesome! I mean, for duty!

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Sunny here. Forecast says clear skies, with a chance of demons.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Kestrel on the wing. Let's hunt.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Scopes warming up. I've got your back.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Krybor frontier. Find that lost signal and hold the sky over the outpost.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Krybor below us. Those families are counting on us. Eyes up.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Frontier skies. Nice and quiet. Wait, never mind.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Frontier signal is faint, but it's there. Following it in.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Ringfall belt. Their supply route runs through these rings. Break it.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Patrol relays everywhere. They'll see us coming, so let's be quick.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Ringfall. Mind the rocks, and mind your six.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Ooh, rings! This sector really put a ring on it.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Ember Moon. Their foundries are building the brood. Shut them down.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Heat's climbing. Keep your engines cool and your aim hot.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Ash cover is heavy. Trust your instruments over your eyes.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Is it just me, or is this moon really, really hot?

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: The Hollow. Those towers answer one command. Cut it.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Something old is watching from those ruins. I don't like it.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Hollow sector. Stay tight. Nobody wanders off.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Kestrel has the high ground. Follow my lead through the towers.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: This is it. The Carrier. Break its field and strike the hatch.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Biggest target we'll ever see. Hard to miss, harder to crack.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: That thing's the size of a moon. Okay. Okay. We've got this.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Every ship in the fleet is watching this feed. Make it count.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Next wave forming up.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Here comes round two!

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: New contacts on the scope.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Another wing inbound. Reset and focus.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Fresh formation, high and wide.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: More of them? Okay. Okay! I'm ready.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Enemy reinforcements incoming!

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: More of them dropping in from above!

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: They called their friends. Rude.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Reinforcements on the scope, high and closing.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Fresh wing arriving. Thin them out fast.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Reinforcements! Party just got crowded.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: New wing incoming, high and fast!

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: More? Where do they keep coming from?

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Sentinel incoming! Big one, coming in high!

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Heavy contact descending. That's a sentinel.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Sentinel on approach. Break its armor before it dives.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Whoa, that's a big one! Sentinel coming in!

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Sentinel class on the board. Watch its eyes for the tell.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: It's diving! Move!

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Sentinel dive! Get clear!

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Big one's committing. Sidestep now!

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Incoming! Dodge, dodge, dodge!

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Dive! Break left or right, now!

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Divers coming down!

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: They're diving at you!

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Attack run. Watch your flanks.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Divers inbound. Keep moving.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: They're coming straight down!

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Dive run! Stay loose!

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Incoming from above, look sharp!

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Gold-plated wing spotted. That's an elite.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Elite in the flock. It'll take more than one hit.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Elite demon sighted. Focus your fire.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Elite marked. Hit it again and again.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Fancy armor on that one. Somebody dressed up.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Look for the shield!

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Shield pickup falling. Grab it!

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Shield module in the air. Go get it.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Free shield! Don't let it fall.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Shield! Shield! It's right there!

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Shield's up. Use it.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Nice catch. You're covered.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Shield online.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Shield up! Now that's a bright idea.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Shield about to run out.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Shield's fading. Careful.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Shield's almost gone. Play it safe.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Your shield's flickering!

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Shield at its limit. Don't count on it.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Shield took that one. You're exposed!

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Shield's down.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Shield spent. Fly careful now.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Shield's gone. Easy does it.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: New toy! Try it out.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Weapon upgrade locked in.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Good pickup. Make it count.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Weapon module online.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Ooh, can I have one of those next?

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Spread shot! Paint the whole sky.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Spread module fitted. Wide coverage.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Spread shot. Good for crowds.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Spread shot! Spreading joy, one demon at a time.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Rapid fire! Let it rip!

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Rapid cannons. Brrrrt!

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Rapid fire online. Keep the pressure on.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: So fast! Can I get rapid fire too?

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Heavy cannons. That'll crack armor.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Heavy shots fitted. Hit them hard.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Heavy rounds. Fewer shots, bigger holes.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Heavy cannons. Choose your targets.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Big shots! Hard to miss now.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Area rounds. They'll splash the pack.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Blast rounds loaded. Boom!

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Blast rounds. Aim into the crowd.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Homing missiles armed!

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Missiles locked and seeking.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Homing missiles! They really get attached.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Seekers loaded. Let them do the aiming.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Bastion sees your missiles. Send some our way!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Ship's totalled, pilot's safe. Next ship, launch!

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Shake it off. You're still in this.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Took a hit. Breathe. Back in.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Ouch! Get them back for that one.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Pod's away and safe. Spare ship's warm. Go.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Ejected clean. Recovery has you. Launch the reserve.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Are you okay? You're okay, right?

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Pod's clear. Breathe. We've got you.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Last ship, pilot. The whole fleet is behind you.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Last one. I believe in you. Let's finish this.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: One ship left. Slow down, pick your shots.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Final reserve ship. Stay calm. You can do this.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: One ship, one pilot. That's always been enough.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Heart assembled. Reserve ship on the line.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Extra ship! You lucky thing.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Spare ship ready. Nice work.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: A whole new ship! You've got a big heart.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Wave's clear. Sweep up the salvage.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Loot time! Grab everything.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Salvage drifting. Collect what you can.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Salvage on the field. Quick pass, then regroup.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Sector secure. Outstanding flying.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: We did it! Sky's ours.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Ha! Did you see that? Textbook.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Scopes clear. Good work, everyone.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Clean sweep. Proud to fly with you.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: That was amazing! Can we do it again?

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Sector's clear. That was beautiful flying.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Clean skies! That's the forecast I like.

lines.speaker: gorrak
lines.gloss: Fine! Take this patch of sky!
lines.say: Fine! Take this patch of sky!

lines.speaker: vexxa
lines.gloss: Enjoy it. I know the way back!
lines.say: Enjoy it. I know the way back!

lines.speaker: ulgra
lines.gloss: You have not seen my next move!
lines.say: You have not seen my next move!

lines.speaker: morth
lines.gloss: Fine! Take this patch of sky!
lines.say: Fine! Take this patch of sky!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Not a single ship lost in this sector. Textbook, all of you.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Every wing accounted for. That's how it's done.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Zero losses! That was out of this world.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Bastion reporting. Every ground team is still standing. Thank you!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: All hands, all ships, all squads. Every one of you is coming home. Fleet intact!

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Beacon confirms. Full roster, no losses. I've never seen it done.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Perfect run! I'm over the moon! All the moons!

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Flawless! Somebody get this pilot a constellation!

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Everybody made it? Everybody? Best day ever!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Ground's all present! Drinks are on Bulwark tonight!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Five tours. Not one ship, not one squad lost. The whole fleet salutes you, pilot.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Thirty years flying, and this is the run I'll tell stories about.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Every wing, every crew, every squad. Fleet intact. Legendary.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Not a scratch on the whole fleet! You're unbelievable!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite to air wing. Every trooper down here is cheering for you.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Lantern here. All lights on, all teams home. Thank you, pilot!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Carrier contact! Break its shield, then hit the hatch!

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Here comes the big one. Shield first, then the core.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Oh, that's huge. That is really, really huge.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Carrier field is up. Wear it down before the hatch opens.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Carrier in range. All fleet guns, support the pilot.

lines.speaker: ulgra
lines.gloss: Welcome to my side of the sky!
lines.say: Welcome to my side of the sky!

lines.speaker: ulgra
lines.gloss: You have come a long way to lose this turn!
lines.say: You have come a long way to lose this turn!

lines.speaker: ulgra
lines.gloss: Look at that tiny fleet. How ambitious!
lines.say: Look at that tiny fleet. How ambitious!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: It's changing form. Stay on the hatch.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Carrier's adapting. New pattern.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Field's down! Hit the core!

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: It's getting angry. Good. Keep going.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: New form. Same weak spot. Find the hatch.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: The Carrier is down! All ships, the fleet salutes you.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: It's falling! It's actually falling!

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Target destroyed. Hell of a run, pilot.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Carrier down! Woohoo!

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Carrier down! Looks like it's lights out for them.

lines.speaker: ulgra
lines.gloss: All right. That was a good move!
lines.say: All right. That was a good move!

lines.speaker: morth
lines.gloss: A rematch! After a short break!
lines.say: A rematch! After a short break!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: All ships totalled, but every pilot is safe. Regroup at base. We go again.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: That's the last reserve. Bring it home, pilot. We'll launch again.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Recovery has your pod. Rest up. The fleet will be ready when you are.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Ground enemies incoming! Ground forces ahead!

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Demon ground troops below. Marking them now.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Movement on the ground. Brood infantry.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Bulwark here. Brood walkers moving on our line!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Bastion to air wing. Enemy armor on the ground, your side of the ridge.

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite here. They're massing below you. Lots of them.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Enemy armor on the ridge! Big ones!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Lantern sees walkers coming over the rocks.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Bastion to all teams, advance. Air wing has our backs.

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite's moving up. Stay close, everyone.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Bulwark advancing. Keep your heads down.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Armor signatures on the ground. Heavy ones.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Ground targets in range. Fire!

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Strafing run! Hit them now!

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: They're under your guns. Take the shot.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Lantern here. They're right under you. Light them up!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: You're right over them. Bring the rain!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: They're close enough to bite! Hit them!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Contact at the wire. Air wing, engage!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: We're pinned down. Need air support!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Please shoot these enemies! They're all over us!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Pick up some homing missiles! We need them off our backs!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Bastion to air wing, my teams are taking fire. Requesting support!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite's surrounded! Anything you've got, send it down!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Lantern to air wing, we're taking fire! Help!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Bastion is under heavy fire! We need you now!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite's taking a beating! Help!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Taking fire, taking fire! Air support!

lines.speaker: gorrak
lines.gloss: You are very protective of that convoy!
lines.say: You are very protective of that convoy!

lines.speaker: vexxa
lines.gloss: A little crowded down there, is it not?
lines.say: A little crowded down there, is it not?

lines.speaker: skarn
lines.gloss: Tell your ground crew I said hello!
lines.say: Tell your ground crew I said hello!

lines.speaker: morth
lines.gloss: That was a warning tap! Keep up!
lines.say: That was a warning tap! Keep up!

lines.speaker: ulgra
lines.gloss: You are very protective of that convoy!
lines.say: You are very protective of that convoy!

lines.speaker: gorrak
lines.gloss: A little crowded down there, is it not?
lines.say: A little crowded down there, is it not?

lines.speaker: vexxa
lines.gloss: Tell your ground crew I said hello!
lines.say: Tell your ground crew I said hello!

lines.speaker: skarn
lines.gloss: That was a warning tap! Keep up!
lines.say: That was a warning tap! Keep up!

lines.speaker: morth
lines.gloss: You are very protective of that convoy!
lines.say: You are very protective of that convoy!

lines.speaker: ulgra
lines.gloss: A little crowded down there, is it not?
lines.say: A little crowded down there, is it not?

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: That did it! Thanks for the cover, flyer!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: They're scattering! We owe you one!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Pressure's off. Bastion thanks you, air wing.

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite's clear! Solid as a rock, thanks to you.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Lantern is clear. Beautiful shooting!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: That's the air wing I know. Thank you.

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: You saved our skins, flyer. I owe you.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Whew. That was close. Thanks, friend!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: You're a lifesaver up there!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: I'm totalled! Going back to base!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Lantern's rig is totalled. We're limping home. Cover the gap!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Bastion's command track is wrecked. Pulling back to base. Hold the line for us!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite's crumbled! Heading back to base to patch up!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: A ground team is heading home for repairs. Cover their retreat.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Bulwark's rig is smoking. Limping back to base!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: I'm totalled, going back to base! Keep them busy!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Tracks are gone. Granite's heading home for repairs!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: I'm totalled, going back to base. You have the field.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Bulwark here. Splashed a walker. Line's holding.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Lantern got one! Scratch one brood crawler.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Bastion reports another contact down. This sector is ours.

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite here. One less demon on the ground.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Ground crews are crushing it down there!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Got one! Scratch that walker!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Lantern's team took out a crawler. Whoo!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Enemy unit destroyed. Good shooting, Bastion.

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Rock solid. Another one down.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Bulwark's still standing and they aren't.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Down it goes! Next!

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Nice work down there, ground team!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: They're pushing harder. Could use some help soon.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: More of them every minute down here. Keep an eye on us.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Bastion to air wing. Pressure is building on our line.

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite's starting to crack. Not yet, but soon.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: We can't hold much longer! Need air support now!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Lantern's line is buckling! Help us!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: All air units, the ground line is about to break!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite's crumbling fast! Send everything you've got!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: The ground line is failing. Give them cover, pilot.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Breakthrough! Enemy ground units in firing range!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: They broke through! Missiles coming your way!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Breach in the line! They're targeting the air wing!

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Ground breakthrough. Watch for missiles from below!

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: They're through the line. Dodge the ground fire!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Keep talking. We can play this all afternoon.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Big words. Tiny firing window.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Your move, then. Try to impress me.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Nice speech. Shame about your aim.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Challenge received. Hold your formation.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Two stars for that threat. Needs more sunshine.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: I can be scary too! Probably!

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Easy, friend. Save some thunder for the next round.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Translation received. Tactical value: questionable.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Noted. Logged. Still ignoring it.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Bastion is staying put. Bring your best move.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Come closer. The ground crew has a comeback.

lines.speaker: gorrak
lines.gloss: Your aim is brave. I will give you that!
lines.say: Your aim is brave. I will give you that!

lines.speaker: vexxa
lines.gloss: You brought a whole fleet for little old me?
lines.say: You brought a whole fleet for little old me?

lines.speaker: skarn
lines.gloss: Come on, pilot. Show me your clever move!
lines.say: Come on, pilot. Show me your clever move!

lines.speaker: morth
lines.gloss: I have all afternoon. Do you?
lines.say: I have all afternoon. Do you?

lines.speaker: ulgra
lines.gloss: That shield will not hide your nervous wings!
lines.say: That shield will not hide your nervous wings!

lines.speaker: gorrak
lines.gloss: You dodge like someone avoiding a chore!
lines.say: You dodge like someone avoiding a chore!

lines.speaker: vexxa
lines.gloss: I was saving that patch of sky!
lines.say: I was saving that patch of sky!

lines.speaker: skarn
lines.gloss: A fine formation. It would look better behind me!
lines.say: A fine formation. It would look better behind me!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Spare ship on deck four, launch! You're clear, pilot.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Reserve fighter is hot. Welcome back to the fight.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: New ship, same pilot. Form up on me.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Fresh paint, fresh engines. Take it easy for a second.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Back in the air. Shake it off.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: There you are! Don't scare me like that.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: New ship smell! Try not to scratch this one.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Reserve ship launched. Shields at full. Blink and go.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Rise and shine! Look who's back.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: You're back! I knew you'd be back!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Bastion sees your new ship. We're still with you.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Ground's glad to see you up there again!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Lantern lights for the new ship. Go get them.

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite here. Solid launch, flyer.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Recovery has your pod. Your reserve is ready. Fly.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Every great pilot loses a ship. Great ones get back up.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Missile up! It's going for you!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Launch from the ground! Break off!

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Missile from below. Move.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Ground launch detected. Sidestep it.

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite sees a missile! Watch out!

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Something's coming up at you!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: We're pushing them back! Keep it up!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: They're running! Bulwark advances!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Line's holding. We've got room to breathe.

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite's moving forward again. Thanks to you.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: The ground line is holding. Well done, everyone.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Pilot, Overwatch. The fleet is moving on your signal. What you do next decides this war.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Beacon here. Long-range scans show the brood massing ahead. Stay sharp.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Every sector you clear brings our people home. Thank you, pilot.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Krybor's frontier is waiting. The outpost families are counting on you, pilot.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Krybor ridge ahead. Brood scouts everywhere. Keep your eyes moving.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Next stop, the Ringfall belt. Break their supply line and the brood starves.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Ringfall patrols are dense. Fly fast, don't linger in the rings.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Ember Moon. Their foundries build every demon you've fought. Shut them down.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: It gets hot over the Ember forges. Trust your instruments.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: The Hollow answers one command. Find it, and cut it.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: The Hollow's towers are broadcasting something. I'll keep listening.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: The Carrier. This is the heart of the brood. Everything we have is behind you.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: All fleet guns are at your disposal. Break the field, then the hatch.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Captain? I just wanted to say I've learned so much from you!

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Do you think I'll get my own ship someday? A real one?

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Quick question. Can demons get sunburns? Asking for science.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Betting pool says you'll beat my score. I put money on you!

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: When this is over, first round's on me. Deal?

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: I logged your last run. Your dodge rate is ridiculous.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Thirty years flying, and you still surprise me.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Between us? You fly like a natural.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: I named my training drone after you! Is that weird?

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Hydrate, pilot. Commander's orders. Well, my orders.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Fun fact: you're the brightest star in this sector.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Admiral says I talk too much. Rook, out. Wait, one more thing.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Terrain change ahead. Convoy, adjust.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Something big coming up ahead of us.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Eyes forward, the ground's changing.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Rough ridge ahead, crawling over!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Ridge line ahead. All tracks, climb and keep spacing.

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite's taking the high ridge. Slow and steady.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Big rocks ahead! Hold on to something!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Valley's clear, rolling through!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Low ground ahead. Watch the slopes on both sides.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Down into the valley. Keep your eyes on the high ground.

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Nice and flat down here. Picking up speed.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Canyon ahead. Single file, nobody stops.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Tight walls in this canyon. Perfect place for an ambush.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Lantern's lights on. It's dark between these cliffs.

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Echoes everywhere in here. Stay quiet, stay quick.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Tree line ahead! Clearing a path!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Trees all over the trail. Cutting through!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Forest ahead. They could be hiding in there.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Into the woods. Keep the convoy tight.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Crystal field ahead. It's glowing. That's not normal.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Mind the crystals, they cut tracks like paper!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Crystal field. Slow speed, steer around the big ones.

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Beautiful. Creepy, but beautiful.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Old ruins ahead. Could be anything in there.

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Ruins on the horizon. Granite will take point.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Rubble on the road. Pushing through the ruins!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: These ruins are ancient. Who built all this?

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Climbing! Engines are screaming down here!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Uphill all the way. Granite doesn't mind.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Steep climb! Lantern's holding on!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Convoy climbing. Cover us while we're slow.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Clearing the tree line!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Cutting through the brush! Branches everywhere!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Making our own road through these trees.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Clearing a path. Keep moving, keep moving.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: We're stuck! Tracks are spinning!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Lantern's bogged down! Keep them off us while we dig out!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite's not moving. Give us a minute!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Convoy halted. Air wing, cover us until we're free.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Contact, left flank! We are trading shots with them!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: They jumped us at the tree line! Returning fire!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Contact front! Convoy, hold your spacing and engage!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Ground units in contact. Keep rolling and keep firing.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Here they come again! Brace and hit back!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Skirmish on the right! I have eyes on three of them!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Fight on the flank, Major. We can handle this one.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Convoy is engaged. Overwatch, we are holding.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Infantry engaged! Boots on the ground, keep them moving!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Foot soldiers in the fight! Squad, on me!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Our infantry is in it now. Covering fire, go!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Infantry engaged. Stay low and stay together.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Their foot troops are swarming the road! Push them back!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Dismounts out! Clear that ridge!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Target down! Moving up!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Got them! Road is clear, rolling on!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: That fight is ours. Convoy, advance.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Good work, all units. Keep the pace.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Artillery made that easy! Thanks for the thunder!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Ha! They did not see that coming!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Skirmish won. Nobody hurt, moving on.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Nicely done. Regroup and press on.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Taking a beating! Falling back to patch her up!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Armour is dented, pulling back for repairs!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: One of ours is falling back to the escort line. Cover them!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Damaged unit falling back. Give them room to repair.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Need a breather! Back in the fight in a moment!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Pulling back! Do not worry, we will be right back!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Heavy armour on the horizon! Everyone, take note!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Big one coming in! That is a heavy tank!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Heavy tank, far ahead! Pilot, can you soften it up?

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Heavy armour rolling in. We will need help from up above.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Heavy armour sighted below. Pilot, keep an eye on it.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Heavy tank down on the ground. Watch the convoy.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: They are surging on the ground! All units, dig in!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Here comes a whole wave of them! Hold the line!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: They are pouring in down here! We could use some help!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Big push coming at the convoy. Steady, everyone.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: The ground attack is surging. Pilot, support the convoy when you can.
